description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeEventService in the OrangeHRM application. It contains test methods for saving employee events, retrieving user roles, and fetching employee events, utilizing mock objects for dependencies.

classes.name: EmployeeEventServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeEventService, testing CRUD operations and user role retrieval with mock dependencies.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Tests that saving an EmployeeEvent via EmployeeEventService correctly calls the DAO and returns an EmployeeEvent with expected ID.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests the saveEvent method, verifying EmployeeEvent creation, setting properties, and returning the correct EmployeeEvent object with metadata.

methods.name: testGetUserRole
methods.description: Verifies that getUserRole returns the correct role name depending on whether a User with a role is provided or not.

methods.name: getUserRoleDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for getUserRole, including a User with a role and null, to verify default system role.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Ensures that the getEmployeeEvents method retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent objects from the DAO.
